[[File:Pups-SWG.png|thumb|150px|An adult Wookiee holding two pups]]
'''Pup''' was a term used to describe a baby or infant [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="gal">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> Wookiee couples traditionally bore two to three pups.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> Those [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] were carried in baby-sacks, known as ''[[quulaar]]'' in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Wookiee-speak]], until they were old enough to climb [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on their own.<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia:English language|English language]], the word "pup" refers most specifically to a young [[Wikipedia:Dog|dog]].<ref name="Dict">{{WebCite|url=http://www.oxforddictionaries.com/definition/english/pup|text=Definition of "pup"|work=Oxford Dictionaries|archivedate=20160326181734}}</ref> [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], the original Wookiee in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]], was based on [[Indiana]], an [[Wikipedia:Alaskan malamute|Alaskan malamute]] dog owned by [[George Lucas]] in the [[Wikipedia:1970s|1970s]].<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>

According to the reference book ''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]'', Wookiee pups were initially set to appear in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], the sixth ''Star Wars'' episode to be produced. Lucas cautioned the creation team not to make Wookiee younglings look like [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], and advised them to explore a "[[Wikipedia:Venice|Venetian]] look." Conceptual drawings of Wookiee children by [[Sang Jun Lee]] can be seen in the book.<ref name="AoSWIII">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> However, when ''Revenge of the Sith'' was released in [[2005]], the idea of showing pups had been dropped, and none appeared in the movie.<ref name="ROS">{{Film|III}}</ref>
